allow: PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'complementary-offer-script|cli\\.js|recommendations' } | Select-Object ProcessId, ParentProcessId, CreationDate, CommandLine | Format-List)

PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CreationDate -gt \(Get-Date\).AddHours\(-1\) } | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CreationDate, CommandLine | Sort-Object CreationDate | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap)
